qldpc_commit_note: The qLDPC commit whose src/ and pyproject.toml the bundle carries, unchanged, and whose wheel it installs. null means not pinned: bundle.py then builds only a trial bundle (--unfrozen), which run_node.py refuses on the node without --allow-unfrozen.
interfaces_note: The qLDPC interfaces beyond the public API that the experiments rely on, by role, for the record of a run; null for one that the pinned commit lacks, such as opt-in work counters.
